name: @kakure/zaddr-wasm
description: Payout-address check for the browser: zcash_address (=0.14.0-pre.2) compiled to WebAssembly, mirroring the operator's check_payout_address (PD18). The built module in generated/ is committed so the web app builds without Rust.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir generated --out-name zaddr --no-pack && rm -f generated/.gitignore
